prototype_hypothesis: Per-symbol AAPCS prototypes recorded with primitive fixed-width types; JSValue is uint64_t scalar, not C struct. Restricted until independent runtime validation.
callsite_evidence: 0xc495f2c feature_register_feature: int(void *, const void *). Registers a retained 28-byte descriptor and invokes lifecycle onRegister; per-app registry, module descriptor must remain resident.

0xc491cd0 feature_manager_post_task: void(void *, const void *). Copies a 24-byte callback descriptor under manager mutex and wakes libuv. Null reference field is supported; callback receives active=0 at manager shutdown.
0xc3f4b64 uv_mutex_init: int(void *). Initializes caller-owned immovable mutex storage via pthread_mutex_init; returns initialization result.
0xc3f4bf8 uv_mutex_lock: void(void *). Locks initialized firmware mutex; may block; do not call from interrupt context.
0xc3f4c14 uv_mutex_unlock: void(void *). Releases caller-owned initialized firmware mutex.
0xc3b982c qjs_new_object: uint64_t(void *). Returns owned JSValue or exception; only call on its JSContext owner task.

0xc3b98d0 qjs_new_c_function2: uint64_t(void *, void *, const char *, int, int, int). Returns owned native function. Cproto=1 takes generic magic ABI fn(context,uint64_t this,int argc,uint64_t *argv,int magic).
0xc3bf280 qjs_is_function: int(void *, uint64_t). Borrows JSValue and tests callability on context owner task.
0xc3ccb00 qjs_call: uint64_t(void *, uint64_t, uint64_t, int, const uint64_t *). Borrows callable/this/argv and returns owned JSValue; exceptions must be taken and released on owner task.

0xc3c3c46 qjs_define_property_value_str: int(void *, uint64_t, const char *, uint64_t, int). Consumes assigned JSValue; uint64_t parameters follow AAPCS integer-pair alignment. This is DefinePropertyValueStr, not shorter SetPropertyStr.
0xc3b69e8 qjs_new_string_len: uint64_t(void *, const char *, uint32_t). Copies UTF-8 bytes and returns owned JSValue or exception.
0xc3b883c qjs_to_cstring_len2: const char *(void *, uint32_t *, uint64_t, int). Returns temporary converted string; caller must free via qjs_free_cstring on owner task.
0xc3b89f2 qjs_free_cstring: void(void *, const char *). Releases string returned by qjs_to_cstring_len2 on owner task.
0xc3b813c qjs_free_value: void(void *, uint64_t). Decrements owned JSValue reference on context owner task.
0xc3b793e qjs_get_exception: uint64_t(void *). Takes runtime exception slot and returns owned JSValue, resetting exception slot.
0xc3e7674 qjs_new_array_buffer_copy: uint64_t(void *, const uint8_t *, uint32_t). Copies bytes and returns owned ArrayBuffer JSValue; input slice borrowed only during call.
0xc3e7f9c qjs_get_array_buffer: uint8_t *(void *, uint32_t *, uint64_t). Returns borrowed backing bytes; caller must retain value, verify attached state and copy before owner task yields.

0xc3e848c qjs_get_typed_array_buffer: uint64_t(void *, uint64_t, uint32_t *, uint32_t *, uint32_t *). Returns owned backing ArrayBuffer JSValue plus typed-array offset/length/element size; binding accepts Uint8Array class22 only.
